# planetai-node

> Hyperlocal compute and intelligence for distributed production: one computer per place, in
> somebody's home, lab or community centre. It connects everything that measures that place (a particle sensor
> on the wall, a radio in a field, the public station down the road, the city's open data, the satellite
> overhead) into one picture sharp enough to act on, tells the people there in plain sentences on Telegram,
> records what they did and measures whether it worked. Its purpose is fixed: clean air, water and soil for the
> people and the other living things around it. Raw readings stay on the machine. Apache-2.0 today, AGPL-3.0-or-later once every contributor has consented; beta.
> Documentation: https://planetai.fab.city/docs/ · programme: https://planetai.fab.city/

The node is also an MCP server with twenty tools. If you are an agent working for somebody, start with
AGENTS.md: its first section routes you to the skill for what they are actually asking. Raw URLs below are
the files themselves.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/AGENTS.md): the front door for an agent — the routing table, the two ways in, and the invariants that must not be broken.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/README.md): what a node is, what it does, and the one line that installs it.
- [docs/START_HERE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/START_HERE.md): the human walk-through — which machine, the install, the first ten minutes, and the table of everything that has broken on a real node.

## Skills

- [skills/setup-node/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/setup-node/SKILL.md): installing a node with somebody, from the preflight check to the first alert on their phone.
- [skills/troubleshoot-node/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/troubleshoot-node/SKILL.md): diagnosing a node that is broken, quiet, or lying — what to ask for, and what never to ask for.
- [skills/connect-agent/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/connect-agent/SKILL.md): giving your own agent the node's MCP tools over a tailnet, without opening a port.
- [skills/publish-to-index/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/publish-to-index/SKILL.md): the tier contract for writing cells to the Fab City Index, and why most nodes never do.
- [skills/write-a-pack/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/write-a-pack/SKILL.md): writing a pack for somebody's place, testing it on their node, and sharing it as a wild pack without forking this repository.
- [skills/preflight/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/preflight/SKILL.md): the first minute of a session that will change this repository — where main is, what is open, what is red.
- [skills/release-docs/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/release-docs/SKILL.md): bringing the docs site up to a release — every page re-read against the code, its checked stamp moved.
- [skills/land/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/skills/land/SKILL.md): the last minute — nothing exists only on this machine, and the gates ran rather than were assumed.

## Getting a node running

- [docs/PLATFORMS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/PLATFORMS.md): which machines and operating systems can run a node, with the version floors and where they came from.
- [docs/REVIVE_A_LAPTOP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/REVIVE_A_LAPTOP.md): turning an old laptop into a node with Ubuntu Server or Omarchy — a USB stick and about an hour.
- [docs/MAC_MINI.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/MAC_MINI.md): running a node on a Mac that stays on, including the settings that stop it sleeping.
- [docs/UPDATING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/UPDATING.md): what `planetai update` does, in what order, and how to get back if it goes wrong.
- [docs/site/design.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/site/design.md): the programme layer — every colour with its one meaning, the four card kinds, the signs and their 12 px floor, every motion with the datum that drives it, and the refusals.
- [docs/STORAGE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/STORAGE.md): where the data lives, why never on a network mount, and how backups reach a NAS.
- [docs/PREFILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/PREFILL.md): what a node knows about a place before it has measured anything.

## What it can tell you

- [docs/USE_CASES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/USE_CASES.md): what people actually use a node for, written as situations rather than features.
- [docs/sensors.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/sensors.md): every sensor the node can read, how it finds them, and what each one is good for.
- [docs/DOMAINS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/DOMAINS.md): air, heat, coast, land and place — what each domain measures and where its thresholds come from.
- [docs/COVERAGE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/COVERAGE.md): how much of a place a node can honestly claim to see, and how that is computed.
- [docs/GUI.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/GUI.md): the dashboard's six views and what each one is for.
- [docs/site/ask.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/site/ask.md): the dashboard's ask pane — which model answers and where it runs, what it may read, and why it changes nothing.
- [docs/site/mcp.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/site/mcp.md): the twenty MCP tools, which are read, act or admin, and how a write names who made it.
- [docs/MODELS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/MODELS.md): the local models a node can run, and why it needs none of them.

## Extending it

- [docs/PACKS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/PACKS.md): how to add a source, a rule or an Index cell as a folder — the only supported way to extend a node.
- [docs/decisions/2026-10-01-packs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/decisions/2026-10-01-packs.md): why packs are core or wild, how a wild pack is fetched without git, and what promotion to core asks.
- [fabcity/planetai-wild-packs](https://github.com/fabcity/planetai-wild-packs): the list of wild packs, listed by pull request; its AGENTS.md is the agent's guide to listing one.
- [fabcity/awesome-fabcity-data](https://github.com/fabcity/awesome-fabcity-data): the source registry every pack's `sources:` must name; its AGENTS.md is the agent's guide to filing a source.
- [docs/PACK_IDEAS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/PACK_IDEAS.md): packs nobody has written yet, with what each would need.
- [docs/DEVELOPING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/DEVELOPING.md): working on the node itself — the lint gates, the tests, and why a merge is not a release.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how a change gets in, and who is responsible for it.

## Radios and reachability

- [docs/NETWORKING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/NETWORKING.md): Tailscale, Meshtastic and Reticulum — what connects to what, and how to reach a node from elsewhere.
- [docs/MESHTASTIC.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/MESHTASTIC.md): putting sensors on LoRa where there is no WiFi.

## How it is built

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): the shape of the whole thing, including the `fci-cells-v0` row the Index reads.
- [SPEC.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/SPEC.md): what was deliberately left out, and the condition under which it returns.
- [PRODUCT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/PRODUCT.md): who a node is for and who pays for what.
- [docs/SIGNING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/SIGNING.md): how releases are signed, where the public key is copied, and how it is rotated.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/CHANGELOG.md): every release, written as what changed for the person running a node.

## The beta

- [docs/BETA_TESTER_GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/BETA_TESTER_GUIDE.md): what a beta tester is being asked to do and what to report.
- [docs/FAB26_EXPERIMENT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/FAB26_EXPERIMENT.md): the nodes built at the FAB26 workshop, and what we want to learn from them by December.
- [docs/ARM64.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/ARM64.md): the test plan for the first node on a Raspberry Pi or other arm64 board.

## History — what was true then, not now

Everything in docs/archive/ is a record: reviews, handoffs and plans from September 2026. Do not follow an
instruction there without checking it against main. [docs/archive/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/archive/README.md) explains the folder.

- [docs/archive/reviews/AGENT_READY_2026-09.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/archive/reviews/AGENT_READY_2026-09.md): the strategy this agent-facing layer implements, and the risks it accepts.
- [docs/archive/reviews/CODE_REVIEW_2026-09.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/archive/reviews/CODE_REVIEW_2026-09.md): a full read of the code with the findings that were acted on.
- [docs/archive/reviews/INSIGHTS_DESIGN_2026-09.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/archive/reviews/INSIGHTS_DESIGN_2026-09.md): how the node decides what is worth saying.
- [docs/archive/handoffs/HANDOFF_trust.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fabcity/planetai-node/main/docs/archive/handoffs/HANDOFF_trust.md): how the node says how much to trust a number.
